newsitem.title: USA: C-Phone allows phone callers to be seen on TV.
newsitem.headline: C-Phone allows phone callers to be seen on TV.

text.p: C-Phone Corp. Wednesday unveiled a home video system which allows users to see on their standard television set whoever they are talking to on the telephone.
C-Phone Home is a self-contained television "Set-Top Box" operated by a wireless remote control and microphone, and connects to a television like a VCR, it said.
With the set turned on, a video call can be speed dialed or answered via the C-Phone Home handheld remote control by pushing a few buttons. On-screen text menus allow the user to operate the system.

C-Phone Home has a suggested retail price of $349.95 plus a monthly video network subscription fee of $19.95, the company said. C-Phone will start shipping the C-Phone Home unit to consumer electronic stores nationwide over the next few months.
C-Phone Corp. is a video conferencing system manufacturer based in Wilmington, N.C.
Its stock rose $1.125 to $5.625 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
